name: Eaglebrook Summer Semester
description_short: Four week boarding program for boys and girls aged 10 to 13 at Eaglebrook School in Deerfield. Mornings are small academic and arts classes, afternoons include sports, and weekends bring trips around New England, with students living in faculty supervised dorms.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Four week boarding program for boys and girls aged 10 to 13, July 4 to 31, 2027; admission requires a transcript, test results when available and teacher recommendations; separate dorms for girls and boys; family style meals in the dining hall; financial aid for domestic students.

Researched by Claude from this page. FAQ: accepting inquiries for 2027; tuition for Summer Semester 2027 is $11,000; runs July 4 to 31, 2027; course options and afternoon athletics (soccer, ultimate disc, basketball, swimming) and Saturday trips. Address 271 Pine Nook Road, Deerfield, MA 01342, 413-774-7411.
